description:
🚀 Team NovaVerse | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

We are curious beginners passionate about space, science, and storytelling. We aim to turn NASA data into creative, engaging experiences.

We welcome teammates interested in research, coding, design, and presentation. No experience required—just curiosity, creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn! 🌎🛰️
summary:
Title: Beyond the Mission – The Machines We Left Behind

Beyond the Mission is an educational storytelling project inspired by NASA's space exploration missions. It explores the stories of spacecraft, rovers, landers and scientific equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars after completing their missions.

Through creative first-person narration, the project gives these forgotten machines a voice, allowing them to share their journeys from Earth, their discoveries, their challenges and their contributions to space science.

The story highlights examples such as the Apollo lunar equipment, Mars Pathfinder and the Sojourner rover, and NASA's Mars exploration rovers. It combines real NASA mission information, scientific data, photographs and engaging visual storytelling to explain how these machines helped humanity understand other worlds.

The project aims to remind audiences that even when a space mission comes to an end, its scientific contributions and technological achievements continue to inspire future generations.

Core message: A mission may end, but its legacy lives on through every discovery it leaves behind.
